verdict.rationale: BVNK is a payments infrastructure API (wallets, virtual accounts, stablecoin pay-ins and payouts). Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role that belongs to agents and AI apps, so the story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows BVNK consuming MCP servers; the agent-wallet-cli probe describes a CLI, not an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
